description: This file defines the 'ModuleDao' class, which manages database interactions related to modules in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to list modules, update their status, retrieve disabled/enabled modules, and manage data group permissions.

classes.name: ModuleDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing module entities in the database, including listing modules, updating their status, and managing permissions.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves all Module records from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the enabled status of specified modules and dispatches status change events.

methods.name: getDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of module names that are currently disabled.

methods.name: getEnabledModuleNameList
methods.description: Returns a list of module names that are currently enabled.

methods.name: updateDataGroupPermissionForWidgetModules
methods.description: Updates read permissions for all user roles associated with a specific data group.

methods.name: getDataGroupByDataGroupName
methods.description: Fetches a DataGroup entity based on its name.

methods.name: getUserRolePermissionsByDataGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves all DataGroupPermission entities associated with a specific data group ID.
